reason: Reliable matches span the southern lakes and coast; a four-parameter similarity avoids unsupported shear in the unsampled northern half.
corrections: Sinclair Island and Port Hebert bank corrected to coast rather than tidal-river feature codes after distance guard rejection.
Stewart reference refined to eastern projecting tip; Cameron southern source refined.
Green Harbour northeastern source roof and Black Point source refined; Forbes reference moved from neighbouring northeastern horn to northwestern horn.
unadopted: Northern Sable/Tidney river junctions and Little Lake outlet could not be precisely reconciled.
Western supposed fork was grant/road detail rather than a confidently identifiable shared water junction.
Port Joli head, Bijou and St Catherine river islands not confidently reconciled.
limitations: All adopted controls and checks are in the southern half. The northern half, northwestern interior, river corridors and much of the coast remain independently unvalidated.
Four checks pair with control waterbodies; Forbes Lake is separate. The small Sinclair Island north/south pair provides little spatially independent information.
Thin generalized lake shores, small island depictions and cape extrema carry 24 px working source uncertainty.
A constrained similarity limits unsupported shear; a numerical pass would not establish accuracy outside the southern sampled strip.
